papers.title: HiMAE: Hierarchical Masked Autoencoders Discover Resolution-Specific Structure in Wearable Time Series
papers.what: Masked autoencoding with a hierarchical convolutional encoder gives one embedding per temporal scale, turning resolution into a probe; it beats scale-collapsing foundation models while running on-watch with sub-millisecond inference.
papers.builds_on: MAE (He, A5HBRQB9); How Mask Matters (Zhang 2023, 6INGKIJV); HARMamba (Li 2024, HE9X47KN)

papers.title: IMPACT: Influence Modeling for Open-Set Time Series Anomaly Detection
papers.what: Uses influence on test risk to relabel contaminated training points and synthesize realistic unseen anomalies, improving open-set detection of unseen anomaly types without losing the seen ones.

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Foundation Models for Clinical Data
papers.what: Represents each patient as a distribution over latent states instead of a point embedding, encoding epistemic uncertainty and improving calibration and robustness under missing clinical data.

papers.title: PerceptionDLM: Parallel Region Perception with Multimodal Diffusion Language Models
papers.what: A discrete diffusion multimodal model with structured attention masking describes several image regions in one parallel pass, gaining inference efficiency over autoregressive region perception.
